definitions.content: Test Laboratory of a manufacturer that is designated by an OIML Issuing Authority, and registered in the Declaration, that performs specific tests under controlled supervision or as a thirdparty laboratory of an OIML Issuing Authority

notes.content: Note 1: A Manufacturer Test Laboratory may conduct tests for the parent company and/or for other companies. The requirements for controlled supervision apply if tests are performed for the parent company. Otherwise the Manufacturer Test Laboratory is considered as a third-party Test Laboratory, in which case the requirements for third-party laboratories must be satisfied.

Note 2: In the event that test data is obtained from a Manufacturer Test Laboratory this must be clearly indicated on the OIML type evaluation report and acceptance of that report is on a voluntary basis.
